# forbidden-paths.txt: paths an officer PR may never change, add, delete or rename away from.
#
# 🔴 THE ONE SOURCE. As it is on the PR's BASE branch, this file is read by BOTH walls:
#   1. the officer agent's push gate (first wall), which reads it from the PR's target branch
#      at every check and refuses the PR if it cannot read or parse it;
#   2. .github/workflows/officer-pr-check.yml (second wall), which reads it from the base
#      commit of the PR's merge ref and fails closed if the base lacks it.
# An officer PR therefore cannot shrink the list it is judged by.
#
# The second wall is an ALLOWLIST as well: a path outside src/ and packages/ fails there
# whether or not it is listed (.github/officer/officer_pr_check.py ALLOWED_ROOTS). The push
# gate has no allowlist, so every top-level entry other than src/ and packages/ is listed
# below; the self-test (.github/officer/test_officer_pr_check.py) fails when a top-level
# entry exists that this list does not forbid. Adding a top-level file or directory to the
# repository therefore means adding it here.
#
# Grammar (the push gate's, ported in officer_pr_check.py match_forbidden):
#   *        any run of characters except '/'      ?   one such character
#   {a,b}    either alternative (no nesting)       **  as a whole segment: any segments
#   dir/     everything under dir (anchored at the repository root)
#   a pattern WITHOUT '/' is matched against EVERY segment of the path, so `package.json`
#   forbids the root manifest AND packages/<pkg>/package.json.
# Character classes and backslashes are refused. One pattern per line; `#` comments.

# ── dependencies: manifests and lockfiles, anywhere ─────────────────────────────
package.json
pnpm-lock.yaml
pnpm-workspace.yaml
package-lock.json
npm-shrinkwrap.json
yarn.lock
bun.lock
bun.lockb
.npmrc
.nvmrc
patches/

# ── database schema and migrations ──────────────────────────────────────────────
prisma/
packages/civitai-db-schema/prisma/
*.prisma
**/migrations/**

# ── environment and secrets ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
.env*
*.env
*.pem
*.key

# ── containers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Dockerfile*
*.Dockerfile
*.dockerfile
.dockerignore
docker-compose*
containers/

# ── CI, hooks, agent instructions and editor config, anywhere ──────────────────
.github
.husky
.claude
.devcontainer
.vscode
CODEOWNERS
CLAUDE.md
AGENTS.md
opencode.json
.gitattributes
.gitmodules
.gitignore
*.sh
scripts

# ── every other top-level entry (the second wall's allowlist, spelled out) ──────
# Directories (anchored at the root).
.browser/
.ladle/
.prompt-analysis-backups/
apps/
claudedocs/
designs/
docs/
media/
ops/
public/
test/
tests/
tools/
# The submodule gitlink.
event-engine-common
# Files. A name without '/' matches in any directory, so these are forbidden inside
# src/ and packages/ too; none of them is application code.
.bundle-budget.json
.editorconfig
.eslintignore
.eslintrc.js
.prettierignore
.prettierrc
CONTRIBUTING.md
LICENSE
Makefile
README.md

flake.lock
flake.nix
lighthouserc.json
next-boost.js
next.config.mjs
playwright.config.ts
playwright.preview.config.ts
postcss.config.js
removedByAuthor
renovate.json
tailwind.config.js
tsconfig.json
